column1: # HOST IS A REPLACEMENT MAINBOARD. The original p14 board died and was replaced; this is
# new board + new power subsystem + BIOS R2XET40W (1.20). The DIMMs are the P16s' own
# 2x 48 GB DDR5-5600 SODIMMs, physically moved over, so RAM is identical to p16s-bench-results.tsv.
# Server: llama-test.service (the p14/disk-prompt-cache fork) -- the SAME server the P16s
# numbers were taken against on 2026-08-21 (verified: llama.service never started that day),
# so p16s-bench-results.tsv and this file are a clean A/B.
# Prompt shape identical to bench-local.sh (1500x code line + nonce => ~18k tok, cold
# prefill, max_tokens=300, temp 0.7). Harness: bench-dpm.sh, 4 interleaved rounds.
# CPU governor left alone at powersave -- closed 2026-08-21 as worth ~0% (p16s.md).
# GPU telemetry sampled at 1 Hz; medians over samples with gpu_busy_percent > 50.
#   dpm-high   PP 374.9   TG 17.81   2900 MHz   46.7 W   84.7 C
#   dpm-auto   PP 350.2   TG 19.67   2247 MHz   24.0 W   67.3 C
# DPM high is +7.0% PP, -9.5% TG, for +94% power and +17 C. It is NOT the ~70% lever the
# README describes -- that lever belonged to the dead board.
# Side by side with p16s-bench-results.tsv (gov-powersave, steady state, round 1 dropped):
# The auto row is the decisive one: IDENTICAL power, 10% HIGHER clock, 4 C COOLER, and still
# 18.5% slower. Not thermal, not a power cap. Throughput-per-clock is down 23-26% in both
# arms, invariant to power state. The board is MEMORY-STALLED -- see TODO item 11.
# HARNESS GAP: this script samples sclk only. mclk/fclk/socclk were never sampled on either
# box, so the memory path has no A/B. Sample all four next time.
